notes.proposed: TFV-first sparse-state + differentiable continuous MPC. Runs on the controls-disabled physical base; priority PFV is soft/diagnostic, never a hard admission gate.
notes.no_control: Same physical network and forcing with [CONTROLS] disabled and no Python setting writes. This is NOT all-open.
notes.internal_rtc: Original frozen event INP with native [CONTROLS] enabled and no Python setting writes.
notes.hold: Controls-disabled base; at the first common control decision freeze the actuator readback vector for the rest of the event.
notes.all_open: Diagnostic controls-disabled policy; from the first common control decision command every eligible continuous setting to 1.0 and hold it there.
notes.all_closed: Diagnostic controls-disabled policy; from the first common control decision command every eligible continuous setting to 0.0 and hold it there.

policy_isolation.common_precontrol_prefix: Proposed, Hold, All-open and All-closed share the same controls-disabled prefix until the frozen control_start_minutes epoch.
